data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Hux represents the ideals of humility and faith. Humility, as the name suggests, means having a small or lowly opinion of oneself and recognizing the greatness and magnificence of God. The idea is to imitate the attitude of Christ who, although being of divine origin, lived a life of service and self-sacrifice. The spiritual significance of the name is an invitation to cultivate a holy detachment from worldly possessions, vanity, and pride, setting one's soul on the eternal reward in heaven.
